stem: A particle starts from rest at x = 0. Its acceleration is 5 m/s<sup>2</sup> which decreases linearly with time to zero in 6 seconds. Find (i) the maximum speed of the particle and (ii) its displacement in time interval t = 0 to t= 2 sec.

assets.alt: Acceleration–time graph in m/s² and s: a straight line falling from 5 at t = 0 to zero at t = 6 s. The shaded triangle is Δv = 15.
Velocity–time graph in m/s and s: a curve rising from zero and levelling off at 15 m/s at t = 6 s. The area up to t = 2 s, 80/9, is shaded.
